name: insight-lite
description: AI-Powered Auto-CFO Platform for Financial Insights

scripts.build:worker: tsc workers/index.ts --outDir dist-worker --module esnext --target esnext --moduleResolution bundler
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:worker
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run build:all && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:all && wrangler deploy --env staging
